description:
One Site Audit check from a site's latest crawl (or run_id): what it means, why it matters, how to fix it, which MCP tools fix it, and the affected URLs with evidence, paginated.

Billing: free — reads the stored crawl; nothing is fetched.

When to call: on a failing check from crawl_site / get_latest_crawl (checks[].id) before fixing it; with compare "new" / "fixed" after a re-crawl.

Returns: { site_id, run_id, check: { id, title, severity, themes, scope, rule, why, fix, fix_tools, semrush_ids }, status: fail|pass|not_run|pending, n, of, items: [{ url, evidence }], total, next_offset, groups?, compare?, vs_previous?, note? }. Site-wide checks have one item; duplicate and broken-link checks add groups on the first call. After fixing: submit_urls with the changed URLs, then crawl_site to confirm. error run_predates_checks: crawl again.

base_run_id.description: With compare: the earlier run to compare with. Default: the crawl this one was compared with.

check_id.description: A check id from crawl_site / get_latest_crawl checks[].id, e.g. "title_missing" or "broken_internal_link".

compare.description: 'new': only pages newly failing since the previous crawl; 'fixed': failing then, not now (fixed, or now erroring or redirecting; evidence from that crawl). Adds vs_previous. Link, image and script checks list new items only.

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

offset.description: Default 0. Use next_offset from the previous answer.

run_id.description: Optional run id. Default: the latest run.

site_id.description: AuditAE site id from list_sites. Or pass domain.

name: get_crawl_issue
title: Get one Site Audit check's affected URLs, evidence and fix
